definitions.full: H2537. Chamutal חֲמוּטַל Qr, חמיטל Kt, proper name, feminine (meaning dubious; perhaps, if Kt right, my husband's father is the dew , compare אֲבִיטַל ) — ᵐ5 Αμειται , Μιτατ ; A Αμιταλ , Αμιταθ , ᵐ5 L Αμιταλ ; — mother of the kings Jehoahaz and Zedekiah, sons of Josiah 2Kin 23:31 ; 24:18 Qr (Kt חמיטל ) = Jer 52:1 Qr (Kt id .)
